items.title_en: Actor admits to eating 'a grain or two' of late mother's ashes before going on stage
items.title_zh: 演员承认在上台之前吃了“一两粒”已故母亲的骨灰
items.summary_en: Rachael Stirling has admitted she eats 'a grain or two' of her mother's ashes before going out on stage. Whether it be stand-up comedians, actors or singers, many who go out on stage have some kind of ritual prior to performing. That could be something to calm the nerves or even a good luck ritual, whatever it may be, we've surely not heard something more bizarre than what Stirling does before the opening night of a play. The 49-year-old lost her mother, Diana Rigg, aged 82 in 2020 after a cancer diagnosis.
items.summary_zh: 瑞秋·斯特林承认，她在上台之前吃了“一两粒”母亲的骨灰。无论是单口喜剧演员、演员还是歌手，许多上台的人在表演前都会有某种仪式。这可能是为了平静神经，甚至是一种好运仪式，无论它是什么，我们肯定没有听到过比斯特林在戏剧首演之夜之前所做的事情更奇怪的事情。 49 岁的母亲戴安娜·里格 (Diana Rigg) 去世，享年 82 岁

items.title_en: Man risks life to sneak into Snake Island where no humans are allowed to visit
items.title_zh: 男子冒着生命危险潜入禁止人类进入的蛇岛
items.summary_en: Brazil's Ilha de Queimada Grande has the nickname 'Snake Island' for a very good reason, it's choc full of loads of snakes. Fortunately for those with a phobia of that which slithers it's located 90 miles away from São Paulo so you'd have to deliberately travel there, and that's unlikely to happen by accident. It doesn't stop people from intentionally journeying there to visit the snakes and put themselves at risk on the 106 acre island which contains around 4,000 venomous serpents . Since there are so many…
items.summary_zh: 巴西的克马达格兰德岛有“蛇岛”的绰号，这是有充分理由的，因为那里到处都是蛇。幸运的是，对于那些对滑行有恐惧症的人来说，它距离圣保罗 90 英里，所以你必须特意前往那里，而且这种情况不太可能是偶然发生的。但这并不能阻止人们特意前往那里探望蛇，并在这个占地 106 英亩的岛屿上冒险，岛上有大约 4,000 条毒蛇。
